names: Diogo Pinto de Freitas do Amaral
summary: Diogo Freitas do Amaral (1941–2019) was a jurist and a founder of the Democratic and Social Centre who was deputy prime minister under Sá Carneiro and held the headship of the government on an interim basis from Sá Carneiro’s death in December 1980 until Francisco Pinto Balsemão was sworn in the following month. He is in the atlas as the interim holder of the office in those weeks.
